articleBody:
- [ ] Accurate cabinet run measurements — Confirms the exact length and depth of the installed, leveled vanity base to guarantee correct overhang dimensions.
- [ ] Level verification of installed base cabinets — Prevents natural stone or quartz tops from cracking due to uneven pressure points.
- [ ] Sink basin model and cutout template — Ensures the fabricator cuts the exact bowl dimensions and faucet hole spacing before arriving on site.
- [ ] Faucet configuration specifications — Confirms whether your plumbing fixture requires a single-hole, 4-inch centerset, or 8-inch widespread drilling setup.
- [ ] Backsplash and side-splash height choices — Protects adjoining drywall from everyday water splash and conceals small gaps along uneven walls.
- [ ] Mirror and medicine cabinet clearance check — Verifies that thicker stone profiles or raised backsplashes will not block swinging cabinet doors.
- [ ] Material porosity and sealant selection — Determines whether your selected stone requires specialized penetrative sealing against cosmetic products and water rings.
- [ ] Plumbing trap and supply alignment check — Confirms existing wall shutoffs clear the under-mount sink basin depth without needing emergency pipe relocation.

How to use this checklist:
Review each item on this list before finalizing your countertop fabrication order. Getting measurements confirmed while cabinets are anchored prevents costly recuts or delays on installation day.
